title: Anomalous craft show interest in White Sands and Los Alamos
place_text: White Sands and Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: more to say about the general interest displayed in White Sands and nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory by uh by uh anomalous technologies.

plain: Unknown craft have shown a special interest in White Sands, a military missile testing range in New Mexico, and in nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory, where America's nuclear weapons were first built, according to Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower. Brown says he has more to say about how these anomalous technologies have hovered around those sites, which would suggest they are watching America's most sensitive weapons work.
